events.prompt: A 26-year-old adult Korean woman with her natural fair skin tone, bright defined features and a wide open smile, light sun-protective makeup and a bright lip, long flax-brown hair with golden face-framing highlights in a low ponytail pulled through the back of a plain white cap. Curvy athletic figure with soft feminine lines, 170 cm tall, bust 90 cm, waist 60 cm, hips 93 cm, E cup, long legs and a slim waist. She wears a white sleeveless fitted knit golf polo, a pale sky-blue pleated golf skirt, white golf shoes and small gold studs. Setting: the edge of a fairway on a clear late-spring morning, bright green grass with dew still on it, fully leafed late-spring trees along the far side, open sky, no golf carts, no flags or signs with text, nobody else around. Moment: she stands on the grass with the head of a single golf club resting on the ground in front of her and both hands stacked lightly on top of its grip at hip height, her weight on one leg, looking down the fairway toward the next hole with an easy, confident smile. Shot: full-length, from a little above her cap to below her shoes, with plenty of fairway and trees around her. Camera: horizontal 16:9, at her waist height, an 85mm lens from about 12 metres, natural perspective. Composition: she stands on the left third of the frame with her body angled to the right, the fairway opening out ahead of her on the right, the line of trees across the upper middle, clear space above her cap and below her shoes. Light: the low morning sun from the right of the frame, ahead of her, lights her face and the front of her body from the side, crisp and directional, with long soft shadows stretching behind her across the grass and sparkles of dew; a soft fill keeps her eyes clear under the cap brim; fresh green, white and pale sky blue. Natural skin texture with visible pores, believable light that belongs to the scene, refined colour grading.

A 22-year-old adult Korean woman with her natural fair, cool-toned skin, a small face, straight shoulders and long narrow upturned eyes, dewy no-makeup makeup with a soft brown liner and gradient lips, long cool blue-black hair tucked behind one ear so its mint-green inner layer shows. Setting: a quiet lake in early autumn just after sunset, a pale wooden deck running out over the still water, the far shore lined with trees just turning yellow, the sky and the lake glowing soft pink and lavender with the afterglow, no bench, nobody else around. Moment: she sits at the far end of the deck with her legs folded to one side and her long skirt spreading over the boards, one hand resting on the boards beside her, gazing out across the lake with a calm, thoughtful half-smile, her face in three-quarter profile toward the camera. Shot: seated full-length, her seated figure filling a little under half the frame height, with the deck, the lake and the far shore around her. Camera: horizontal 16:9, from a little above her seated head height, angled slightly down, a 50mm lens from about 5 metres, natural perspective. Composition: the deck runs in diagonally from the lower right corner and ends on the right third, where she sits, her face and figure clear and recognisable; the far shore lies across the upper third, above her head and never crossing it; the glowing water fills the left side. Light: the sun has just set beyond the far shore on the left of the frame, and the brightest part of the afterglow sky there lights her face softly as she looks toward it, with a faint pink sheen on the water and on her hair; the far shore is darker against the sky; soft pink, lavender, lake blue-grey, cream and deep wine. Natural skin texture with visible pores, believable light that belongs to the scene, refined colour grading.
